name: Tarte au citron
description: Manage features which use cookies (ads, social networks, videos, other contrib modules who print data in your pages)
project_description:
Manage features which use cookies (ads, social networks, videos, other contrib modules who print data in your pages) 

 With this module, you can use additionnal modules (plugins) which interact with other core/contrib modules such as : 

 
 Tarte au citron Add To Any 
 Tarte au citron Google Tag Manager 
 Tarte au citron Media Remote Videos 
 Tarte au citron reCAPTCHA 
 
 You can also use plugins provided out of the box by tarte au citron library (Please refer to step 3 from install documentation ), in this case, you need to adapt HTML by yourself, as required by tarte au citron plugins. 

 Once dependent modules installed and configured, you will have to go to the configuration page of the module and allow services.

 Configure at Administer > Configuration > Tarte au citron > Settings for Tarte au citron module. 

 You can also edit texts for the cookies banner/modal from the configuration page : Configure at Administer > Configuration > Tarte au citron > Texts settings for Tarte au citron module. 

 With this module, you don’t need to tweak the HTML rendering of contrib modules which are requiremenents from tarte au citron library.

This is made autommatically, depending of which tarte au citron services you have enabled.

For example, once tarte_au_citron_google_tagmanager module is enabled. It adds a new service Google Tag manager which, if enabled too, will directly interract with the google_tag_manager contrib module and prevent it from adding everythings in DOM that needs to be done by tarte au citron library.
